exercises.prompt: Prove K>=D^2 for positive fixed cash flows
exercises.derivation: For wi=vi/V and sum wi=1: sum wi(ti-D)^2=sum wi ti^2-2D sum wi ti+D^2 sum wi=K-D^2>=0. Equality iff every positive-weight time equals D. Assumptions finite positive C, finite nonnegative t, real finite r and representable helper report.
exercises.execution: Selected E14, equal-time, all-time-zero and single-payment output variance comparisons. Caller composition subtracts rounded K and D^2 with1e-14 absolute allowance; this numerical sampling is not a universal proof or strict inequality gate.
